positive.prompt: Triage incoming bug reports, deduplicate issues, and convert approved tickets into formal specifications using docs/agents/.
Onboard an agent onto this repository with Wayfinder and decompose the project PRD into tracker-ready actionable tickets.
Standarisasi workflow repositori, issue triage, to-spec, dan to-tickets dengan memisahkan state docs/agents/ dari instruksi skill.

negative.prompt: Decompile this APK using jadx and reconstruct the API endpoint URLs
Tests fail and the API throws unexpected 500 errors in production, find what broke and fix the root cause

evals.prompt: We receive messy user bug reports on our issue tracker. How can we standardize agent onboarding, triage incoming bugs, and produce actionable specifications?
evals.expected_output: A workflow architecture based on Matt Pocock's skills standard: separating repo configuration in docs/agents/, using Wayfinder for onboarding, systematic triage, to-spec, and to-tickets decomposition.
expectations: Separates repo configuration in docs/agents/ from skill logic for tracker portability
Applies Wayfinder for repo orientation and entrypoint discovery
Provides structured issue triage with deduplication and severity ranking
Converts triaged issues into formal specs and actionable decomposed tickets
